basis: Manual source-image comparison of the prepared contact sheets. Approval requires the existing OCR candidate to preserve the complete question text and all visible symbols, numbers, units, and options or source-backed graphical content.
year_note: The prepared 30-record adversarial sample was reviewed for every year. Records with OCR typos, dropped equations/charges/units, truncated text, or incomplete option/list content were intentionally retained for further review, so the requested per-year promotion minimum is not claimed where the candidate did not pass visual comparison.
